title: Flipper's Retreat | KEY.co
description_expanded: Tucked into a serene coastal community, this two-story beach cottage is an idyllic retreat for both relaxation and adventure. With its calming palette of coastal blues and soothing neutrals, the living area beckons families and friends to unwind in comfort after sun-drenched days. Mornings are a delight in the spacious kitchen, where bright white cabinetry and gleaming stainless steel appliances invite culinary exploration. A generous kitchen bar and dining space become the heart of the home, perfect for leisurely brunches or animated evening feasts.
